		remove_character_modifier = tv_court_physician_effect
		remove_character_modifier = busy_modifier
	}
	var:tv_court_physician_location ?= { remove_location_modifier = tv_court_physician_disease_control_modifier }
	remove_variable = tv_court_physician_character
	remove_variable = tv_court_physician_location
	set_variable = { name = tv_court_physician_ability value = 0 }

}

tv_court_positions_refresh_physician_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_court_physician_country
	var:tv_court_physician_character ?= { remove_character_modifier = tv_court_physician_effect }
	var:tv_court_physician_location ?= { remove_location_modifier = tv_court_physician_disease_control_modifier }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_court_physician_character }
		var:tv_court_physician_character ?= { save_scope_as = tv_court_physician_holder }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:tv_court_physician_holder = { is_alive = yes } }
			scope:tv_court_physician_country = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_court_physician_ability value = scope:tv_court_physician_holder.adm }
				clamp_variable = { name = tv_court_physician_ability min = 0 max = 100 }
				if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_physician_action } var:tv_court_physician_action < 1 var:tv_court_physician_action > 3 } } set_variable = { name = tv_court_physician_action value = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_court_physician_action = 1 has_variable = tv_court_physician_location }
					var:tv_court_physician_location ?= { add_location_modifier = { modifier = tv_court_physician_disease_control_modifier days = -1 mode = replace size = { value = var:tv_court_physician_ability divide = 100 } } }
				}
			}
			scope:tv_court_physician_holder = {
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = busy_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = tv_court_physician_effect days = -1 mode = replace size = { value = scope:tv_court_physician_country.var:tv_court_physician_ability divide = 100 } }
			}
		}
		else = { scope:tv_court_physician_country = { tv_court_positions_remove_physician_effect = yes } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = tv_court_physician_ability value = 0 } set_variable = { name = tv_court_physician_action value = 0 } }
	clear_saved_scope = tv_court_physician_holder
	clear_saved_scope = tv_court_physician_country
}

tv_court_positions_initialize_country_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_court_positions_initialized value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_physician_ability } } set_variable = { name = tv_court_physician_ability value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_tutor_ability } } set_variable = { name = tv_court_tutor_ability value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_steward_ability } } set_variable = { name = tv_court_steward_ability value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_architect_ability } } set_variable = { name = tv_court_architect_ability value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_cultural_emissary_ability } } set_variable = { name = tv_court_cultural_emissary_ability value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_chronicler_ability } } set_variable = { name = tv_court_chronicler_ability value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_physician_action } } set_variable = { name = tv_court_physician_action value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_tutor_action } } set_variable = { name = tv_court_tutor_action value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_steward_action } } set_variable = { name = tv_court_steward_action value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_architect_action } } set_variable = { name = tv_court_architect_action value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_cultural_emissary_action } } set_variable = { name = tv_court_cultural_emissary_action value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_chronicler_action } } set_variable = { name = tv_court_chronicler_action value = 0 } }
	tv_court_positions_refresh_all_effect = yes
}

tv_court_positions_monthly_effect = {
	tv_court_positions_refresh_all_effect = yes
	tv_court_physician_disease_scan_effect = yes
}

tv_court_positions_yearly_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_court_physician_character var:tv_court_physician_character ?= { is_alive = yes } var:tv_court_physician_action = 2 }
		random = { chance = 10 trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_court_physician.1 days = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_court_physician_character var:tv_court_physician_character ?= { is_alive = yes } var:tv_court_physician_action = 3 }
		random = { chance = 20 trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_court_physician.2 days = 1 } }
	}
}

tv_court_physician_disease_scan_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_court_physician_scan_country
	random_character = {
		limit = {
			is_alive = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_physician_disease_notified }
			OR = { has_trait = trait:sickly has_trait = trait:smallpox_trait has_trait = trait:bubonic_plague_trait }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_physician_disease_notified } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_court_physician_disease_notified value = 1 }
			save_scope_as = tv_court_physician_candidate
			scope:tv_court_physician_scan_country = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_court_physician_pending_patient value = scope:tv_court_physician_candidate }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_court_physician.10 days = 1 }
			}
			}
		}
	every_character = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { OR = { has_trait = trait:sickly has_trait = trait:smallpox_trait has_trait = trait:bubonic_plague_trait } }
			has_variable = tv_court_physician_disease_notified
		}
		remove_variable = tv_court_physician_disease_notified
	}
	clear_saved_scope = tv_court_physician_candidate
	clear_saved_scope = tv_court_physician_scan_country
}

	if = {
